jobs.occupation: Flavourist or Junior Flavourist
jobs.description:
Are you our new flavourist?

If you are a curious person with a passion for taste and educated within flavour creation and formulation, looking for new opportunities, and you want to experience the Scandinavian culture with great work/life balance, then Einar Willumsen is the right place for you!

Einar Willumsen is a modern mid-sized international flavour house with own in-house analytics, flavour creation and application departments, and production facilities for flavourings and compounds. With a mission to help customers develop exciting and innovative taste experiences, inspired by Nordic food traditions. Our core competencies include flavour creation, analytics, and applications across various industries.

We are looking for a passionate Flavourist or Junior Flavourist who will be part of the Flavour Creation team, working closely together with other flavourists, analytical chemists and laboratory technicians, under the support of a principal flavourist.

Role description

• Overall flavour development – R&D and new flavour creation

• Flavour formulation for different types of application (beverages, confectionery, bakery, dairy and others)

• Sensory evaluation

• Re-formulation of flavours depending on different requirements

• Flavour compounding and sample preparation

• Raw materials selection, testing and approval

• Stability-, solubility test and shelf-life evaluation

• Data collection and measurements

• Projects coordination and administration

• Sparring with application specialists

• Production upscaling and implementation of newly developed products

• Technical support and close cooperation with other departments and customers

Qualifications

• 
Flavourist education (Master’s degree) or Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, or related field followed by flavourist training

• 
Experience in flavour creation and formulation

• 
Competencies in technical aspects of flavour composition and flavour development, including:

• Sensory Evaluation skills

• Research and Development (R&D) skills

• Laboratory Skills in a food-related setting

• Knowledge of food regulations and standards

• 
High level of creativity

• 
Good communication and collaboration skills

• 
Being able to work fully independently but in close collaboration with team members and other departments

• 
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks

• 
Problem-solving mindset

• 
Self-motivated with a positive attitude and drive to achieve goals

• 
Fluent in English

We offer

A full-time on-site role for a Flavourist/Junior Flavourist at Einar Willumsen in Brøndby Municipality in Denmark. And an informal and multinational work environment with room to be challenged and develop your flavourist skills. A great canteen with home-cooked lunch, social activities and a salary package including pension, health insurance and other benefits are also some of the things we also offer.

Next step and application

If this sounds like an interesting opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. Please send your application and CV to job@ewflavours.com

As we wish to hire our new colleague as soon as possible, we will invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

About Einar Willumsen

Einar Willumsen (EW) was founded in 1901, and today we are the leading Nordic manufacturer and supplier of flavours, extracts, distillates and compounds for the food and beverage industry. Our headquarter is in Brøndby, and we have a subsidiary in Malmö. In EW, you get approximately 120 colleagues with approx. 10 different nationalities. EW’s largest shareholder is a foundation that donates part of the profits to cancer research and research in other diseases. We have a strong financial foundation for our ambitious growth strategy. EW is based on and still lives by strong Nordic values, such as flexibility, innovation, reliability and of course our overall motto: “When taste and speed matter”.

Building & shipping

Senior Software Engineer | Machine Control

Help shape the future of machine automation.

Every day, construction professionals around the world rely on Leica Geosystems technology to work more safely, efficiently, and more sustainable.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in kinematics and control systems to join our On-Machine Software team in Odense, Denmark, or Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will develop the software that enable construction machines to operate with greater precision, automation, and autonomy.

About the role

You will be part of the On-Machine Software department, where we design and develop developing technology used every day on construction sites around the world. Our software allows construction machines to understand their surroundings and execute precise movements.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture discussions to implementation, testing, and operational support. You will collaborate with software, hardware, and product teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

A particular focus of this role will be supporting and evolving key machine control applications while contributing expertise in system design, software architecture, kinematics, control systems, sensor integration, and advanced software development practices.

What you’ll do

• Develop and maintain software for machine control and automation systems.

• Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and system design.

• Take ownership of key software components and drive improvements.

• Collaborate across software, hardware, and product teams to deliver reliable solutions.

• Develop machine guidance, automation, and control functionality.

• Participate in technical reviews and mentoring of colleagues.

• Work with sensor integration, positioning technologies, and control algorithms.

• Contribute to technical investigations and innovation initiatives.

What you'll bring

You have a degree in Software Engineering, Robotics, Control Engineering, or a related technical discipline and several years of professional software development experience.

You thrive on tackling complex system-level challenges and are often the person colleagues turn to for technical guidance. While you work well independently when needed, you also enjoy collaborating with others and sharing your expertise in our global organization.

We expect you to have:

• Strong C++ development skills.

• Experience developing software on Linux-based platforms.

• Experience working across the full software development lifecycle.

• Understanding of software architecture principles and object-oriented design.

• Experience developing sensor-fusion and state-estimation solutions.

• Deep understanding of kinematic modelling and control systems, ideally applied to robotics, mobile machinery, hydraulic systems, or automation.

Additional experience:

• Experience with embedded and real-time software development.

• CAN, CANopen, or similar communication technologies.

• Understanding of CRA, cybersecurity compliance, and secure software development practices.

• Experience developing safety-critical or safety-certified software.

• Experience from heavy construction, industrial automation, agriculture, or related industries.

• GNSS, positioning systems, or machine guidance solutions.

Language: Fluent English, both written and verbal, is a prerequisite.

Travel: Occasional travel may be required, for example to visit other development locations.

At Leica Geosystems, you will be working on technology that truly matters to the people who use it. For over 40 years, we've helped construction professionals build more efficiently, more safely, and more sustainably. Our products are used in more than 80 countries and are integrated with over 10 leading OEM construction machinery manufacturers. Today, more than 10,000 of our systems shape roads, railways, and infrastructure every day.

Leica Geosystems Machine Control is part of Hexagon's Infrastructure & Geospatial Business Area. Hexagon is the global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. Because when it has to be right, it has to be Hexagon.

Healper a game-changing booking platform that matches people with mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and addiction with the psychologist who fits their needs. Problem: The cumbersome booking of the wrong psychologist In Denmark, mental disorders account for 25% of the disease burden and cost society 55 billion DKK annually with more than 2,000 people receiving therapy from a psychologist every day. Further, too many individuals do not receive timely help as they cannot cope with the draining 5-hour process it takes to find and book a psychologist. At the same time, U.S. experience shows that only 20-40% of people find a psychologist they trust and have 'chemistry' with. This is tragic, as just one bad experience can cause a client to completely drop out of or postpone his/her therapy. The ineffective booking process and the risk of a poor patient-therapist match mean that many people continue to struggle with mental illness who could otherwise be treated. This has major consequences for individuals whose mental illness markedly impairs their quality of life, but also largely affect their family and friends. Furthermore, this is a major problem for society, which is negatively impacted by lost labor and growth and must shoulder the high costs associated with mental illness. Solution: A simple approach to booking the right psychologist Healper is a friendly guide and a booking platform that matches clients with psychologists. We have designed a comfortable, simple, and transparent user journey, that takes the client by the hand and helps him/her through therapy to mental health. Clients fill out a short questionnaire and are then matched with the best results from our database of more than 1,700 psychologists. Here, we find the psychologist who can statistically give the best treatment. Clients are presented with a prioritized list of three psychologists along with the reasons for the match. From this list, clients can choose which psychologist they like best, book a session, and pay. The platform continuously facilitates feedback from clients and their psychologists to improve the processing and precision of the matches.

jobs.occupation: Lifting & Rigging Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description:
About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Lifting & Rigging Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support a major construction project.

As the project’s technical specialist for lifting and rigging, you will help ensure that lifting activities are properly planned, reviewed and executed safely. You will provide specialist guidance to the project team, contractors and subcontractors and support compliance with applicable legislation, project procedures and recognized industry practice.

The role requires extensive practical and technical experience with lifting operations on large construction or industrial projects.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Acting as the project’s subject matter expert for lifting, rigging and crane-related activities.

• 
Developing, reviewing and maintaining project procedures and minimum requirements for lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing lift plans, risk assessments, method statements and supporting technical documentation.

• 
Assessing routine, non-routine, complex and critical lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing crane selection, load charts, lifting radius, capacity utilization and equipment configuration.

• 
Verifying load information, including weight, dimensions, center of gravity and lifting points.

• 
Reviewing rigging arrangements, lifting accessories and equipment selection.

• 
Assessing crane positioning, ground conditions, outrigger loads and required ground support in cooperation with the relevant engineering disciplines.

• 
Ensuring that exclusion zones, communication methods and responsibilities are clearly defined before lifting begins.

• 
Confirming that lifting equipment and accessories have valid certification, inspections and identification.

• 
Reviewing the competence and documentation of crane operators, riggers, signalers, lifting supervisors and other personnel involved in lifting operations.

• 
Supporting contractor and subcontractor evaluations related to lifting competence and performance.

• 
Participating in planning meetings, constructability reviews, pre-lift meetings and toolbox talks.

• 
Conducting site inspections and audits of lifting and rigging activities.

• 
Identifying unsafe conditions, procedural deviations and technical risks and ensuring that these are addressed.

• 
Supporting coordination between construction, logistics, engineering, HSE and commissioning teams.

• 
Advising the project on simultaneous operations and interfaces that may affect lifting activities.

• 
Supporting investigations of lifting-related incidents and near misses and communicating lessons learned.

• 
Maintaining clear records and reporting lifting-related risks, observations and required actions to project management.

• 
Reviewing and approving lifting documentation when formally authorized to do so by the project.

Qualifications and experience

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant technical, engineering, crane, rigging or construction background.

• 
Extensive documented experience with lifting and rigging operations on large construction or industrial projects.

• 
Previous experience as a lifting specialist, appointed person, lifting manager, lift planner, lifting supervisor or equivalent.

• 
Strong knowledge of cranes, rigging equipment, lifting accessories and safe lifting practices.

• 
Experience developing and reviewing lift plans, risk assessments and method statements.

• 
The technical ability to review load information, crane configurations, load charts and rigging arrangements.

• 
Knowledge of equipment certification, inspection and traceability requirements.

• 
Strong understanding of HSE requirements associated with lifting operations.

• 
The confidence and experience to challenge unsafe or technically inadequate lifting arrangements.

• 
Strong communication and coordination skills.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

Relevant lifting-planning or appointed-person qualifications recognized in the project’s jurisdiction will be an advantage. The precise certification requirements will depend on the project location and client requirements.

Experience from major pharmaceutical, energy, infrastructure, data-centre or other technically complex construction projects will also be an advantage.

Personal qualities

You are:

• 
Safety-conscious and technically thorough.

• 
Confident when making and communicating specialist decisions.

• 
Structured in your review of plans, calculations and documentation.

• 
Comfortable working with contractors, engineering teams and senior project management.

• 
Practical and able to translate technical requirements into workable site solutions.

• 
Prepared to intervene and escalate when lifting operations cannot be performed safely.

What we offer

At Solvexis, you will be supported by a professional and responsive organization throughout your assignment. We provide structured onboarding, administrative support, documentation assistance and regular project follow-up.

You will have an influential specialist role on a technically demanding project, working closely with construction, engineering, logistics and HSE professionals.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.

Your CV should clearly describe your experience with:

• 
Complex and critical lifting operations.

• 
Lift planning and technical review.

• 
Crane and rigging activities.

• 
Major construction or industrial projects.

• 
Relevant lifting qualifications and certifications.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.
